rationale: W0, one shot. A hinge network in log space on top of the quasi-steady d2-law: the linear part is the B-number law (oxygen mass fraction, diluent, pressure, size); nine hidden units add the concavity in oxygen, radiative loss of large flames, water uptake and the heat-up transient. Extinction is an intensity per unit burn progress centred on a hand-written extinction progress w_ext(conditions, size) with deliberately wide spread. The run's own rate enters through two finite differences of the prefix with a hand-written gain. Every number is a hypothesis written before the model was run; see edits.wsp and MODEL_CARD.md.
